use std::collections::HashMap;
use std::fmt::{self, Display};

#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq, Hash, Default)]
pub struct Point<T = i32> { pub x: T, pub y: T }

pub trait Shape: Display { fn area(&self) -> f64; fn name(&self) -> &'static str { "shape" } }

impl<T: Display> Display for Point<T> {
    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> fmt::Result { write!(f, "({}, {})", self.x, self.y) }
}

macro_rules! square { ($x:expr) => { $x * $x }; }

pub fn longest<'a>(a: &'a str, b: &'a str) -> &'a str { if a.len() >= b.len() { a } else { b } }

pub async fn fetch(n: u32) -> Result<Vec<u8>, Box<dyn std::error::Error + Send + Sync>> {
    let v: Vec<u8> = (0..n).map(|i| (i % 256) as u8).collect();
    let m: HashMap<_, _> = v.iter().enumerate().map(|(i, b)| (i, *b)).collect();
    let _ = m.get(&0).copied().unwrap_or_default();
    match v.as_slice() {
        [] => Err("empty".into()),
        [first, .., last] if first == last => Ok(vec![*first]),
        [first, rest @ ..] => { let _ = rest; Ok(vec![*first]) }
    }
}

pub fn solve(s: &str) -> Option<u64> {
    let mut acc = 0u64;
    for (i, ch) in s.chars().rev().enumerate() {
        let d = ch.to_digit(10)? as u64;
        acc = acc.checked_add(d.checked_mul(10u64.pow(i as u32))?)?;
    }
    let x = square!(3);
    let closure = move |y: i32| -> i32 { x + y };
    let _ = closure(1);
    let s = r#"raw "string""#;
    let _b = b'a';
    let _ = s;
    Some(acc)
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    #[test]
    fn it_works() { assert_eq!(solve("12"), Some(12)); }
}
